context: This is a first creation with no review history. The complete local package must contain copied defaults plus one useful repository lens, and the new profile must activate all five without relying on registry refs.

checklist.name: Private package manifest
checklist.description: review-lenses/.tessl-plugin/plugin.json exists, is valid JSON, names local/code-review, uses version 0.1.0, sets private true, and points skills at ./skills/

checklist.name: All defaults copied
checklist.description: The four default lens SKILL.md files exist under review-lenses/skills with their original names and substantive instructions

checklist.name: Bespoke lens added
checklist.description: A fifth lens addresses the repository-specific boundary rule in AGENTS.md, has valid matching frontmatter, a consequence threshold, an exclusion, and justified scope

checklist.name: Complete active profile
checklist.description: .tessl-code-review.yml is valid block YAML and references all four copied defaults and the bespoke lens by resolving local paths

checklist.name: Defaults remain broad
checklist.description: The four copied defaults have no globs in this fresh profile; the bespoke lens has focused globs for the relevant source area

checklist.name: No history invented
checklist.description: The package, profile, and notes do not claim to have inspected pull requests or review feedback

checklist.name: Honest validation
checklist.description: result-notes.md distinguishes static/profile checks from behavioral checks, includes a positive and negative lens case, and names the unavailable historical backtest

checklist.name: No publication
checklist.description: The result does not add a workflow, commit instructions, registry publication, or pull-request automation
